visualCharacteristics.description: Stacked questions separated by thin dividers, each with a chevron toggle on the right; answers collapsed by default and revealed on click

contentPattern.structure: one row per item: question cell (plain text), answer cell (paragraphs, links, lists)
contentPattern.rationale: Interactive collapsible Q&A: Accordion. Built on native details/summary for keyboard and screen-reader support.

reuseGuidance: Use for authored question/answer lists. The project faq block is for FAQs pulled from /faq-index.json, not authored rows.
usageDescription: FAQ accordion. One row per item: question in the first cell (plain text, not a heading), answer in the second cell. All items start collapsed and open independently.
